Form CS13
January 2002
SCARBOROUGH BOROUGH COUNCIL
RISK ASSESSMENT
&
SAFE WORKING PROCEDURES FORM
Department: Port Services Assessment No: 25
Section: Whitby Harbour Assessment Date: 10 April 2008
Task or Operation: Leisure Vessel Operations
Location: Whitby
Hazard(s): Collision, Strong river flows, heavy seas at harbour entrance, trips and
falls
Risk: Controls:
Collision All vessels comply with the
requirements of the international
collision regulations.
Protocol in place for safe navigation
within the port.
Safe speed warning notices in place.
Guidance literature to be given to
launching craft and new customers.
Strong river flows Warnings in navigational publications
and on charts.
Harbour staff will inspect moorings
and alert owners if deficient.
Warning notices to be erected at
access to berths.
Vessel should not attempt to
manoeuvre during spate conditions.
